title: CASS 15 Daily Safeguarding Reconciliation Calculator
description: Computes the CASS 15.8 internal and external safeguarding reconciliation for a UK payments/e-money firm: per-customer build-up floored at zero (15.8.31R), unallocated funds included in the requirement, safeguarding resource by component (15.8.26R), shortfall/excess verdict per currency, and same-day rectification note (15.8.50R). Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

perCurrency.description: Per-currency requirement, resource, difference and verdict

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_cass15_safeguarding_reconciliation
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes the UK CASS 15.8 daily safeguarding reconciliation: per-customer individual balance build-up floored at zero with no cross-customer netting (15.8.31R/15.8.30R), unallocated funds included in the requirement until allocated (15.8.30R(2)), safeguarding resource summed across the four CASS 15.8.26R component types, shortfall/excess/reconciled verdict computed independently per currency (no FX conversion), and the same-day rectification timing note (15.8.50R). Documented-non-standard-method toggle per 15.8.37R. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/634-cass15-safeguarding-reconciliation-calc.html for interactive use.
